'''John-Michael Earwood''' (GEMP handle '''JM''') is a member of [[Team 5]].<ref name="forum-81218">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (arebelspy), Players Committee Forums (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). Wiki copy: [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]].</ref> He finished 21st at the [[2017 Match Play Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/match-play-championship/ 2017 Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
